object: capabilities or platform features for processing traditional trade finance instruments such as documentary letters of credit, standby letters of credit, bank guarantees, bonds, or documentary collections
findings: The company reports that its core trade finance solutions focus exclusively on receivables and supply chain financing, including export invoice factoring, invoice financing, post-shipment trade finance, distributor finance, inventory finance, vendor finance, and dynamic discounting.

The company reports that its blockchain-based digital platform facilitates automated supplier self-onboarding, real-time in-principle approval, buyer risk assumption, and digital portal visibility for managing credit limits up to $10 million.
We verified that the company's product offering is restricted to supply chain and receivables finance structures rather than a full suite of core trade instruments.
